screens.title: Tempo: same layout
screens.why: The bar and the + stay; the row is centred and the list ends clear of it.

pins.label: One centred row
pins.text: Bar and + as one row, centred on the column (centerFloat), both 56 px tall so their middles line up.

pins.label: 🎤 records here
pins.text: Tap starts recording on the spot; no sheet opens.

pins.label: Room at the end
pins.text: List padding = bottom bar + safe area + 16 + 56 + 24 (was a fixed 112), so the last card and its + scroll above the row.

screens.title: Talking on Tempo
screens.why: The bar opens across the + into a WhatsApp-style recorder; the words rise above it as heard.

pins.label: Words as heard
pins.text: Settled in ink, still being revised in grey, red caret. Card on surface with the bar's shadow.

pins.label: ↑ into the chat
pins.text: Tapping the card opens the conversation; the recording carries on there (one shared VoiceCubit).

pins.label: 🗑 discard
pins.text: Drops the recording; the bar and + come back.

pins.label: ● 0:03 + wave
pins.text: Breathing red dot, timer, live bars centred on a line: the voice-note look.

pins.label: ■ tap again = stop
pins.text: Where the mic was. Stops and opens the chat with the words in the field.

screens.title: Still talking, in the chat
screens.why: Same recorder, in the composer's place; the words sit where they'll be sent from.

pins.label: Draft bubble
pins.text: The words in a fill bubble on the right, live, until stopped.

pins.label: Same VoiceBar
pins.text: One widget for Tempo and the chat; the mic in the composer starts it too.

screens.title: Stopped: text, selected
screens.why: Nothing is sent by surprise: the words land in the field, all selected, keyboard up.

pins.label: Preselected
pins.text: Send as is, fix a word, or type over everything.

pins.label: ↑ send
pins.text: The one accent; sends with the spoken length kept ('por voz · 0:03').

screens.title: Bar tapped: straight to typing
screens.why: No greeting, no suggestion chips: the sheet opens on the focused field.

pins.label: Nothing suggested
pins.text: The welcome and its four chips are gone; past conversations still pull down from above.

pins.label: Focused
pins.text: Keyboard comes up with the sheet; the mic in the field records like the one on Tempo.
